sn29.8:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn29.8:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā jalābujānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti || || 4-6
sn29.8:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī || So yeva peyyalo || || 7
sn29.8:1.5: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā jalābujānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
